description: This file contains functions related to retrieving and processing MAC addresses from various hardware sources, including device tree, files, and encrypted memory partitions. It includes utility functions for accessing device-specific MAC addresses, converting and canonicalizing MAC address formats, and interacting with different hardware components such as MTD partitions, MMC, and UBI volumes. The file likely serves as a library of system-level functions for device initialization or configuration in an OpenWrt-based environment.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads the first 6 bytes (MAC address) from a specified file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC label from device tree alias or local address.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC label from a JSON configuration file.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to get MAC address label from device tree; if unavailable, falls back to JSON.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for an MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts a MAC address string from a part of device data, canonicalizing it.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address in ASCII form from an MTD partition by name.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition specific to Arcadyan devices.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition specific to Deco devices.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UBI volume configuration.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address text from a partition at a particular offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address from UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Gets the size of an MTD partition by name.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address in ASCII from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Retrieves binary MAC address from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC (last 3 octets) of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the device's CID hash for MMC devices.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Converts a MAC to EUI format string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administration' bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address, with specific bits unset.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts various MAC address formats to canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled (status=okay).
